description: Landing page for Voximplant’s IVR order tracking. Customers call, say a waybill number or their name, and hear where their order is.
team: I worked directly with Voximplant’s engineering team. Their developers built the page.

hero.alt: The first screen of the landing page on dark purple: the last word of the heading changes from faster to simpler to more convenient, and the pointer moves over the top button, then over Watch video and Try for free

flow.title: From the first screen to a test call
description: The first screen says that tracking works by voice, with no digits to type. Below it, a demo window plays a call over a map of Moscow, and the bot answers where the parcel is and when it will arrive.

Four cards list what the service does: several orders in one call, 98% recognition accuracy, a report on order status and delivery dates, and CRM integration. The bot speaks in the voice people know from Yandex.Navigator.
The test call window shows a number to dial and a code to enter once the call connects, with a 30-second timer. After that, you say the answers the page suggests.

media.alt: The whole landing page: the first screen, the demo call over a map of Moscow, the Yandex.Navigator voice block with four cards, the footer, then the test call window with the number, the code and the timer
